headline: S&P Upgrades South Africa Rating to One Notch Below Investment Grade
summary: S&P upgraded South Africa's credit rating to its highest level since 2017, placing it one notch below investment grade.
why: Sovereign credit ratings influence government borrowing costs, foreign capital inflows, and broader macroeconomic sentiment in emerging markets.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: S&P upgraded the sovereign credit rating of South Africa.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: An upgrade by a major credit rating agency lowers perceived sovereign risk, often boosting local bond and currency performance.
